summary: OpenAI is previewing a new API service tier, Ultrafast, that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster using Cerebras hardware, reaching up to 750 output tokens per second.

categories.reason: The new inference tier is explicitly powered by Cerebras chips rather than standard GPUs, indicating demand for that specialized accelerator silicon.
categories.quote: Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

practices.reason: The throughput gain is tied to Cerebras's own hardware and serving stack rather than a technique an engineering team could apply on its own infrastructure.
